scope: Current v9 24 static portraits,22 prepared1024 derivatives, four canonical transparent pets and their current formal copies/crops/rebuild-support copies. No v11 edits.

method.visual: Directly displayed all23 unique v9 portrait pictures plus the byte-identical second canonical-hero path; also the existing22-person overview, all4 full pets and4 current pet portrait crops. Additional in-memory native hair crops for05/07 on neutral dark background protect intended purple design.
method.mechanical: Verified current v9 and pet manifest hashes;22 prepared outputs checked against current source LANCZOS resize by pixel comparison;8 full-pet copies and12 corresponding portrait copies checked for byte equality. RGBA alpha hashes recorded per current file.
method.limits: Read-only review and two review-file writes only. No images generated, transformed on disk, repaired, published or integrated into a client. Color counters support localized review and are not blanket masks. Exposure is visually assessed, not a claim of new tonal processing.

style_policy: 整体道家Q版；春节/元宵/中秋只按适用素材少量点缀。全部角色设计保留。直发可束髻或编辫。身份、肤色、体态、职业色系和现有曝光保持。

color_exceptions.05: 银紫直发、紫袖、琴体与流苏属于确认的设计；局部髪色检查支持保留，不按强品红总数全图清除。
color_exceptions.07: 靛紫短发、紫色刃饰是角色本色；保留现有月影配色，不把非零色阈值计数当成必须全图去紫。
color_exceptions.14: 紫眼、紫兔眼、手套与细饰位于此前保护区域，当前白发/毛边干净；保留现有已局部清理结果。
color_exceptions.ling_yue: 白毛内部淡紫蓝阴影属于狐毛设定，应保护；尾尖与狐吻完整。
